## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed endpoints have unit tests and an integration test in `test/integration/`
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented in `docs/` and `README.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
- [ ] No API keys, card data or webhook secrets in code, tests, fixtures or logs
